name: Sleepwalker
source:
You’re a troubled soul, wracked with guilt and trauma and too many problems to even know where to begin. Luckily, that’s what the doctor’s for.

To unpack your past in the day, and reflect on the day in the night. This is your life.

No, not ‘life’. Death. 

But it’s not so straightforward. One person strives to help you, while the other strives to keep you trapped in the clutches of limbo forever. You don’t know whose intentions are pure.

You’re trying to earn your rite of passage to the afterlife, but the whispers in your ears conflict each other at every turn. Who do you trust to see you through to your final destination? 

[From [url=https://summer-light-studios.itch.io/sleepwalker]itch.io[/url]]
